note:
66 -> 62: two tests in core/utils/indexed_db.test.js gained expect.assertions guards, four sites in one commit (1223bbff922). Both assert inside the callback handed to IndexedDB.execute(), so a callback that stopped being invoked would take the store-names assertion with it while the read assertions outside stayed green. Counts are 6 and 8; the first attempt wrote 4 and 6 because ensureDbIsAbsent() asserts twice on its own, and Hoot reported the true number rather than leaving them counted by eye. Measured in a clean detached worktree of HEAD with node_modules symlinked; the shared checkout carries another session's orphaned comment sweep and is not usable for this reading.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

New gate, first floor. 66 masked assertion sites in addons/web/static/tests: an assertion inside a deferred function (a handler, a callback, a class method) that runs only if something invokes it, in a test that ALSO asserts in its own straight-line flow. That second condition is the gate -- Hoot already fails a test running no assertion at all, so an unmasked dead handler is caught today and reporting it would be debt the tree does not have; without the masking condition the count is 112. Guards recognised and not reported: expect.assertions(n)/verifySteps, a sentinel the function sets and the test asserts outside it, and the asserted result of the call the function was handed to. Validated against the defect it was built for: reports plop() on t_custom_click.test.js at 9e26c220cdf~1, silent on the fixed file. The class-method form -- the one 800c9912f02's defect hid behind -- is at zero; the 66 are inline callbacks, a smaller risk each and a test-by-test judgement to drive down, not a sweep. Measured in a clean detached worktree of the commit that adds the gate, node_modules symlinked.
